channel.title: Trade Show News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Trade Show News Network (tsnn.com)

item.title: As Data Valuations Cool, What Does That Mean for Events Businesses?
item.description: M&A Advisor Adam Shaw shares why AI concerns pressuring data company valuations are actually strengthening the investment case for events businesses, as live gatherings generate irreplaceable proprietary intelligence that digital channels cannot replicate.

item.title: Government Shutdown Looms
item.description: ECA's Tommy Goodwin explains how the impending third DHS shutdown since October could impact the industry this time around.

item.title: IAEE Inks Deal to Acquire EXHIBITORLIVE and EXHIBITOR Magazine
item.description: IAEE will acquire Exhibitor Group by April 30 to create a unified ecosystem serving both exhibition organizers and exhibitors.

item.title: Evolving Expectations Off the Show Floor Lead Latest Wave of Hotel Upgrades
item.description: Properties across the country are investing millions in renovations, new concepts, and ultra-luxury accommodations to impress attendees long after the convention doors close.

item.title: Done Deal: LVE Expands West Coast Operations With Acquisition of Innovative Expo
item.description: With the purchase of California-based Innovative Expo, LVE has expanded its regional footprint to enhance client support capabilities across the West Coast market.

item.title: Questex Unveils Platform to Scale Curated Business Matchmaking Across Event Portfolio
item.description: Questex has launched Q Connect and Q Connect Premium, a new connection framework that uses first-party audience intelligence to deliver curated one-to-one meetings and executive experiences across its global event portfolio

item.title: Gary Shapiro, the CES Ninja, Reflects on a Remarkable Journey
item.description: The president and CEO of the Consumer Technology Association talks to TSNN about overcoming obstacles to create the country’s most in-demand trade show.

item.title: San Diego Convention Center CEO Rip Rippetoe to Retire After Decade of Record Growth
item.description: San Diego Convention Center CEO Rip Rippetoe will retire after 10 years of leadership that included navigating the COVID-19 pandemic and achieving record-breaking economic impact of $1.6 billion in fiscal year 2025.

item.title: Event Security Expert Warns Against Reactive Approach as Threats Evolve
item.description: Global Awareness Professionals President Mark Herrera explains why updated event security training should focus on frontline staff empowerment and early behavioral threat detection as traditional security approaches prove inadequate against evolving risks.

item.title: International Builders Show Draws 75,000 to Final Orlando Trade Show Before Move to Las Vegas
item.description: The annual home-building trade show, which is moving to Las Vegas next year, introduced the new AI & Tech Studio and offered attendees the opportunity to tour the official show homes located just outside Orlando.
